ideas.title: ESLint Fails with `Parsing error: Cannot read file tsconfig.json` After Switching to Flat Config
ideas.description: Explain why ESLint can no longer find the TypeScript project file and how to point the parser at the right path.
ideas.angle: Open with the parser error and the config file path ESLint is trying to read. Explain how flat config changes resolution rules, so `parserOptions.project` no longer behaves like it did in legacy config setups. Show the corrected absolute or relative paths, the working `tsconfigRootDir`, and how to avoid loading the wrong project file in a monorepo.

ideas.title: Cloudflare Workers Reject a Second Read with `TypeError: body used already` After `request.text()`
ideas.description: Fix Workers handlers that consume a request body twice and learn when to clone or cache the parsed data.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact `body used already` error and the second read that triggers it. Explain the Fetch request stream model: once a body is consumed, it cannot be read again unless you clone the request or preserve the parsed result. Show how to structure middleware and validation so the body is read once and reused safely.

ideas.title: Deno Fails to Resolve an npm Package Imported Without the `npm:` Prefix
ideas.description: Show why Deno treats bare npm specifiers differently and how to import packages with the right resolver rules.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact Deno resolution error and the package specifier that fails. Explain the distinction between URL imports, npm compatibility, and lockfile-driven resolution in Deno. Cover the fix with `npm:` specifiers, `deno.json` configuration, and any permission or cache step required for the package to resolve consistently.

ideas.title: Remix Loses Session Cookies on a Cross-Site Callback Because `SameSite` Blocks the Cookie
ideas.description: Explain why a Remix session cookie disappears on a third-party redirect and how to set cookie attributes correctly.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact symptom: the callback route cannot read the session cookie after the redirect. Explain how browser cookie rules treat `SameSite=Lax`, `SameSite=Strict`, and `SameSite=None; Secure` during cross-site navigation. Cover how to configure the session storage cookie in Remix, when to use `Secure`, and how to validate the callback flow without breaking local development.

ideas.title: Nginx Sends the Wrong Host Header to an Upstream App Behind a Reverse Proxy
ideas.description: Show how Nginx rewrites Host and `X-Forwarded-*` headers and how to preserve the original domain upstream.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact upstream symptom, such as the app generating redirects or absolute URLs for the proxy host. Explain how Nginx sets `Host`, `X-Forwarded-Host`, `X-Forwarded-Proto`, and `X-Forwarded-For` by default and why applications depend on them for canonical URLs. Show the proxy configuration needed to pass the original host through and how to confirm the upstream sees the expected request metadata.

ideas.title: Cloudflare Workers Read `undefined` Environment Bindings Because `wrangler.toml` Does Not Declare Them
ideas.description: Show why a Worker sees missing secrets or vars at runtime and how to define bindings in `wrangler.toml` correctly.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact `undefined` binding error or the missing value seen in the Worker runtime. Explain how Wrangler injects vars, secrets, and service bindings from configuration, and why undeclared bindings do not exist at runtime. Cover the schema for `[vars]`, `kv_namespaces`, `d1_databases`, and secrets, plus the deployment step needed for the runtime to receive them.

ideas.title: Vite Throws `Module "fs" has been externalized for browser compatibility` When Browser Code Imports Node Built-ins
ideas.description: Explain why Vite externalizes Node built-ins in browser bundles and how to keep server-only modules out of client code.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact Vite error and the import chain that reaches `fs`, `path`, or another Node built-in. Explain how Vite decides what belongs in the client bundle and why server-only modules must not be pulled through a shared entry point. Show how to separate client and server imports, use conditional code paths or `.server` files where appropriate, and confirm the bundle no longer includes Node-only dependencies.

drafted.title: Vercel Builds a Next.js App with `process.env` Undefined in Client Code
drafted.description: Show why browser bundles cannot read server-only env vars and how to separate build-time, server, and client values.
drafted.angle: Open with the exact undefined value in the browser bundle or shipped code. Explain the difference between variables embedded at build time, runtime server variables, and `NEXT_PUBLIC_` values that are intentionally exposed to the client. Show how to move server-only reads out of client code and how to verify what ends up in the bundle.
